content.text: {"requirements":[{"id":"R-1","text":"読書会の記録アプリを作成する。","quote":"読書会の記録アプリを作ってください。","position":{"start":0,"end":18}},{"id":"R-2","text":"メンバーを名前付きで登録できること。","quote":"- メンバー（名前）を登録できること","position":{"start":19,"end":37}},{"id":"R-3","text":"本を書名と著者付きで登録できること。","quote":"- 本（書名・著者）を登録できること","position":{"start":38,"end":56}},{"id":"R-4","text":"読書会を記録し、開いた日、取り上げた本、参加したメンバーを記録できること。","quote":"- 読書会（開いた日・取り上げた本・参加したメンバー）を記録できること","position":{"start":57,"end":92}},{"id":"R-5","text":"本ごとに、取り上げた回数が分かること。","quote":"- 本ごとに、取り上げた回数が分かること","position":{"start":93,"end":113}},{"id":"R-6","text":"今月開いた読書会の回数を、ダッシュボードで確認できること。","quote":"- 今月開いた読書会の回数が、ダッシュボードで分かること","position":{"start":114,"end":142}}],"decisions":["位置は原文本文の0始まりで数え、endは範囲に含めない。","「取り上げた本」は読書会1回につき1冊、「参加したメンバー」は複数人として扱う。","「本ごとの取り上げた回数」は、その本を取り上げた読書会記録の件数として扱う。","「今月」は日本時間の当月として扱う。"],"unresolved":[]}

{"declaration":"entities:
  - name: member
    fields:
      name: string
  - name: book
    fields:
      title: string
      author: string
  - name: readingSession
    fields:
      openedOn: date
      book:
        type: ref
        to: book
      participants:
        type: list
        of: member
views:
  - name: memberList
    entity: member
  - name: bookList
    type: table
    entity: book
    show: [title, author, featuredSessionCount]
  - name: readingSessionList
    entity: readingSession
  - name: dashboard
    type: dashboard
    widgets:
      - type: number
        value: monthlyReadingSessionCount
actions:
  - name: addMember
    entity: member
    kind: create
  - name: addBook
    entity: book
    kind: create
  - name: addReadingSession
    entity: readingSession
    kind: create
validations: []
computed:
  - name: featuredSessionCount
    entity: book
    type: number
    aggregate:
      count: readingSession
      where:
        book: this
  - name: monthlyReadingSessionCount
    scope: app
    type: number
    aggregate:
      count: readingSession
      where:
        openedOn:
          within: this_month
permissions:
  - name: read
    subject: minIdentity
  - name: write
    subject: minIdentity
minIdentity:
  mode: anonymous","mappings":[{"roleId":"member","name":"member"},{"roleId":"member.name","name":"name"},{"roleId":"member.addMember","name":"addMember"},{"roleId":"member.memberList","name":"memberList"},{"roleId":"book","name":"book"},{"roleId":"book.title","name":"title"},{"roleId":"book.author","name":"author"},{"roleId":"book.addBook","name":"addBook"},{"roleId":"book.bookList","name":"bookList"},{"roleId":"readingSession","name":"readingSession"},{"roleId":"readingSession.openedOn","name":"openedOn"},{"roleId":"readingSession.book","name":"book"},{"roleId":"readingSession.participants","name":"participants"},{"roleId":"readingSession.addReadingSession","name":"addReadingSession"},{"roleId":"readingSession.readingSessionList","name":"readingSessionList"},{"roleId":"book.featuredSessionCount","name":"featuredSessionCount"},{"roleId":"monthlyReadingSessionCount","name":"monthlyReadingSessionCount"},{"roleId":"dashboard","name":"dashboard"}]}
